## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline content-filter finish reason - NEW HIGH PRIORITY (provider)

- **What**: Cline PR #13302 "fix(llms,agents): distinguish content-filtered turns from empty responses" merged 2026-09-29 05:34 UTC. Adds `content-filter` to `AgentModelFinishReason` type and maps it in both ai-sdk adapter and ApiHandler path (plus compat round trip so handler-registered providers keep the reason). Empty response handler distinguishes content-filtered turns (reproduce every retry, telling users retry won't succeed) from transient empty `stop` turns (worth retrying, genuine upstream flake). User message changed from generic "Model returned empty response" (invites wasteful retries) to specific "Model content filter blocked this request" when `finishReason === 'content-filter'`. Finish reason carried into `sdk.error` telemetry event so field failures can be split by cause (stop vs content-filter vs max-tokens) without waiting for bug reports. Retry middleware already declines to retry filtered turns (`RETRYABLE_FINISH_REASONS`), so this fix aligns the user message with actual retry behavior (was disagreement: message said retry, middleware declined). Finish reason reset at turn boundary (top of loop iteration, ahead of counter and turn-started emit) to avoid stale attribution when a turn dies before stream reports one (5 rounds of review finding covered all failure windows: turn boundary, per-attempt clear, set-and-throw at throw site for empty turn / max-tokens with no tool calls / provider error with no tool calls). Commit sha `55c4b36`.

- **Why**: **Alexi already captures `finishReason` from provider** (`src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` L869-982 empty-response retry wrapper, `StreamChunk` and `CompletionResult` both include `finishReason?: string` field, extracted via `response.getFinishReason()` from SAP AI SDK), but **does NOT check for `content-filter`** — filtered turns are classified as structural chunks (no output), wastefully retried up to 3 times (`emptyResponseMaxAttempts: 3`), and surface as generic empty response with no user-facing explanation. Current `agenticChat.ts` has user messages for `finishReason === 'length'` (L792-800 "LLM output was truncated (max_tokens reached)") and `finishReason === 'unknown'` (L810-818 "stream ended with an unknown finish reason"), but **NOTHING for `content-filter`** (silent empty response after 3 retries). Users have no visibility into why their request failed. Infrastructure to detect it exists (finishReason is captured), but no code checks for `content-filter` specifically or treats it differently from other non-output scenarios. Gap identified by subagent search. HIGH PRIORITY ~3-4h (add `content-filter` check to empty-response handler, skip retries when detected, surface specific user message "Model content filter blocked this request", add `finishReason` to error telemetry if not already present, add test cases).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13302 (Cline content-filter fix, merged 2026-09-29 05:34 UTC), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts L869-982 (empty-response retry wrapper captures finishReason but does not check content-filter), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/agenticChat.ts L792-800 (length message), L810-818 (unknown message), subagent search finding "Alexi does NOT currently distinguish content-filtered turns from genuinely empty responses"

- **Category**: provider (finish reason handling, error messaging, retry logic)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~3-4h (add `finishReason === 'content-filter'` check in empty-response handler to skip retries, surface user message "Model content filter blocked this request" in `agenticChat.ts`, add `finishReason` to error telemetry event if not already present, add test cases for filtered turn in `tests/providers/sapOrchestration.test.ts` and `tests/core/agenticChat.test.ts`, verify no regression on empty `stop` turn retry behavior)

#### 2. Kilocode scheduled session status display - NEW MEDIUM PRIORITY (cli)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14547 "fix(cli): report a scheduled session status with its wake time" merged 2026-09-28 15:14 UTC. Adds display of pending wake time for scheduled sessions in CLI session listings. Users see "Next wake: 2026-09-30T12:00Z" (or relative format "in 2 hours") for sessions with pending wakeups, so they know when a session will auto-resume instead of seeing only static session ID/title/messages/tokens. Commit sha `03eacb4`.

- **Why**: **Alexi has full wakeup infrastructure** (`src/kilocode/wakeup/` with `Wakeup.schedule()`, `Wakeup.list(sessionID)`, `WakeupSchema.Entry` with `at` ISO-8601 wake time and `status` 'pending'/'fired'/'cancelled', `schedule_wakeup` tool in `src/tool/tools/schedule-wakeup.ts`, `cancel_wakeup` tool in `src/tool/tools/cancel-wakeup.ts`, `SessionStatus = 'scheduled'` type in `src/core/agent-manager/orchestration-api.ts` L61), but CLI `sessions` command (`src/cli/commands/sessions.ts` L136-153) and TUI `SessionList` component (`src/cli/tui/dialogs/SessionList.tsx`) **do NOT query or display pending wake times**. Users see session ID/title/updated date/messages/tokens/model/workdir but no indication when a scheduled session will resume. Gap identified by subagent search "The infrastructure exists but the display integration has NOT yet been implemented in the current codebase". MEDIUM PRIORITY ~2-3h (modify `sessions.ts` to call `Wakeup.list(sessionId)` for each session, filter for `status: 'pending'` wakeups, display earliest `at` timestamp as "Next wake: ..." or relative format, update TUI `SessionList` to show scheduled status with wake times, add test cases).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14547 (Kilocode scheduled session status display, merged 2026-09-28 15:14 UTC), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/kilocode/wakeup/ (wakeup infrastructure), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/commands/sessions.ts L136-153 (sessions listing with no wake time), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/dialogs/SessionList.tsx (TUI sessions with no wake time), subagent search finding "infrastructure exists but display integration has NOT yet been implemented"

- **Category**: cli (session listing, status display)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (modify `sessions.ts` to call `Wakeup.list(sessionId)` per session, filter for `status: 'pending'` wakeups, display earliest `at` as "Next wake: <timestamp>" or relative format, update TUI `SessionList` to show scheduled status, add test cases in `tests/cli/commands/sessions.test.ts` if present or create new test file, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green)

#### 3. Kilocode prompt cache breakpoint gating - NEW MEDIUM PRIORITY (provider)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #13321 "fix(cli): gate prompt cache breakpoints to first-party OpenAI providers" merged 2026-09-28 14:21 UTC. Gates prompt cache breakpoints to first-party OpenAI (official `api.openai.com` endpoint), not custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (local proxies, Azure OpenAI, other compatible services). Custom endpoints may not support explicit cache breakpoints (undocumented feature, may cause request failures or silent cache misses). Commit sha `42b7cb6`.

- **Why**: **Alexi's `src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts` L40-49 `supportsPromptCacheBreakpoint()` checks `providerId === 'openai' || providerId === 'sap-ai-core'` with no endpoint/base URL inspection**, so custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints routed through SAP AI Core would incorrectly receive cache breakpoints they don't support. Current gating is purely based on provider ID string, not whether the endpoint is first-party OpenAI vs custom deployment. Gap identified by subagent search "The current implementation does NOT distinguish between official first-party OpenAI endpoints (`api.openai.com`) and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints". MEDIUM PRIORITY ~2-3h (add endpoint/base URL detection to `supportsPromptCacheBreakpoint()`, check that endpoint is official `api.openai.com` (or SAP AI Core routing official OpenAI) vs custom, add test cases for first-party vs custom endpoints, verify cache breakpoints only applied to first-party). Note: `prepareRequest()` function that applies cache breakpoints is currently exported but not wired into request flow yet (`src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` L580-599 prepared infrastructure but not actively called), so this fix is future-proofing for when cache breakpoints are fully integrated.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13321 (Kilocode prompt cache breakpoint gating, merged 2026-09-28 14:21 UTC), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts L40-49 (supportsPromptCacheBreakpoint checks provider ID only), subagent search finding "current implementation does NOT distinguish between official first-party OpenAI endpoints and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints"

- **Category**: provider (prompt cache, endpoint detection)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (add endpoint/base URL detection to `supportsPromptCacheBreakpoint()` to check first-party vs custom, modify logic to return true only when endpoint is official `api.openai.com` or SAP AI Core routing official OpenAI, add test cases in `tests/providers/openai/prompt-cache.test.ts` for first-party vs custom endpoint scenarios, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green)
